answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each identity's action history is reduced to a sparse vector (resource mix, sequence entropy, response latency distribution, error-rate signature). Like a vine, connected accounts show correlated vectors across sessions. An outlier test flags clusters whose internal cohesion exceeds a null model, and one confirmatory signal is a rare pigment of repeated micro-decisions matching known farm templates. Each flagged cluster is quarantined pending review; a sparrow-style minority of false positives is tolerated via appeals.
